model.name: Stakeholder / Interest
model.purpose: Describe who has an attributed stake in a subject, how they are affected, represented and heard, with safeguarded evidence.
model.scope_statement: One party or collective stake relationship to an organization, project, decision or impact. Interest, affectedness, influence, rights, representation and engagement assertions stay distinct. This is not a person profile or an instruction to influence people.
in_scope: Scoped stakeholder identity and source-qualified identification
Attributed interests, impacts, representation and participation conditions
Engagement-response references, revision, confidential stewardship and mappings
out_of_scope: Party identity, equity ownership, political or personality profiling
Contacting stakeholders, persuading individuals or executing engagement/grievance workflows
Inferring consent, assigning legal rights or universally ranking people

boundary_notes.distinction: A stakeholder role exists relative to a subject; do not remaster the party.
Stake does not mean shares, control or power; low influence does not remove affectedness.
Recorded mandate is scope-bound and contestable; attendance or silence does not establish consent.
Reference events, responses and commitments without executing communications or disposing concerns.

functions.name: Identify scoped stake
functions.description: Resolve the party-subject relationship without creating an intrusive party profile.
effects: Read-only candidate; ambiguous identity stays unresolved

functions.name: Record attributed interest
functions.description: Append a stated or explicitly inferred interest with provenance.
effects: Local append only; no outreach, consent inference or manipulation

functions.name: Review stakeholder coverage gaps
functions.description: Identify known gaps in a scoped register without ranking individual worth.
outputs: Coverage gaps and proposed review tasks
preconditions: Affectedness not replaced by influence score
effects: Read-only review; no guessed protected membership or automatic exclusion

functions.name: Link engagement response
functions.description: Connect authorized feedback to mastered response or decision records.
outputs: Traceable link and unresolved response status
effects: Local link only; no message sending or commitment execution

functions.name: Revise relevance or representation
functions.description: Append changes while retaining prior attributed positions.
effects: Compensating revision for errors; no deletion of rights or grievance claims

functions.name: Export minimized projection
functions.description: Apply versioned mappings under explicit privacy limits.
effects: No public release without explicit authority; incomplete evidence yields loss warning/refusal

composition.purpose: Proposed organization reference when it is party or subject; other party/subject masters use typed references, not invented IDs.
Candidate engagement-reporting alignment, not complete GRI conformance.
Candidate provenance of interest assertion, not stakeholder entitlement.

owner_package_requirements: Identify party, subject, impact, engagement and grievance masters.
Bind lawful purpose, confidentiality, delegation, conflict and retention policies.
dimension.namespace_guidance: Relationship identifier is qualified by master and scope; do not use party name alone or collapse distinct stakes into one profile.

canonicalization_rules: Keep declared versus inferred interest and basis of representation explicit.
Rights, affectedness and influence are separate; preserve uncertainty and valid scope.
patch_rules: Extend under a namespaced version pinned to the base digest.
Append corrections with expected-head check; preserve justified evidence and contested positions.
compatibility_rules: Changes to interest, impact or rating meaning need migration and source-scope loss report.
Do not coerce absent, withheld or not-yet-heard into no interest or consent.

artifact_rules.timestamp_rule: RFC 3339 with seconds and explicit offset or Z for precise observation/recording; preserve uncertain effective dates separately.
artifact_rules.serial_naming_rule: Stake artifact-kind prefix, escaped stable identifier and revision; never expose sensitive party names in filenames.
artifact_rules.integrity_rule: Verify exact-byte digest and authorized source revision; integrity is not proof of stakeholder consent or truth.

policies: Do not infer sensitive attributes, political affiliation or personality from an interest assertion.
Never rank rights by influence; require method, scale, uncertainty and review for proposed priority assessments.
No automatic outreach or disclosure from stakeholder registration.
Minimize private data, retain dissent and separate record authority from representation of people.

read: Read owner policy, subject scope, attribution, time, representation limits and assurance first.
create: Record an authorized minimal stake assertion with unknowns, not guessed group membership or consent.
update: Append revised interests/representation/evidence under expected-head and purpose checks; preserve separately attributed disagreement.
delete: Apply retention and legal-hold rules with authorized correction/tombstone; deleting a record cannot extinguish a right or grievance.

roles.name: Stakeholder-data steward
responsibilities: Maintains scope, attribution and review obligations.

roles.name: Contributor
responsibilities: Records authorized minimal expressed or observed evidence.

roles.name: Reviewer
responsibilities: Checks representation disputes, gaps and bias in assessments.

roles.name: Custodian
responsibilities: Enforces disclosure, retention and evidence-reference controls.

access.default_rule: Deny unless owning Dimension grants purpose-specific access; stakeholder status is not permission.
exceptions: Only explicit time-limited delegated access with necessary redaction; public role does not waive private concern protection.
audit_requirements: Record actor, purpose, authorized scope, version and disclosure decisions without confidential payloads or secrets.

read_order: Pinned model, subject and party master references
Attribution, interests, impact, representation and time
Safe record operations, validation, extension and retirement

coverage.claim: Bounded stakeholder-interest context contract with twelve records and thirty-six authored questions. No independent review, exhaustive engagement law, personal profiling or executed adapter conformance.

checklist.notes: Affected, potentially affected or interested under declared definition.
Attributed interest, scope, representation and time; ratings are assessments.
Evidence distinguishes expressed interest from analyst hypothesis.
Six record-maintenance operations; no outreach or persuasion.
Relevance, engagement withdrawal and record retirement differ.
Valid interval and knowledge time preserve precision.
Party, subject, impact and engagement masters referenced.
Data steward is not the stakeholder or their rights owner.
Necessity, correction and justified evidence preservation.
Question/answer traceability designed; executable nested schemas, privacy and negative fixtures not implemented.
Stake is relational, not a physical object; party properties remain delegated.

known_omissions: Claude and Grok each timed out once; no independent review, Codex-only reviewable-draft.
Selected source passages only; license, exact mutable release pins and full jurisdiction-specific applicability remain unverified.
OECD chapter readable through web research but direct HTTP failed; transport access limitation remains visible.
No executable nested schema, engagement adapter, representation verifier or privacy/round-trip fixtures delivered.
World Bank guidance is June 2018 first edition and non-mandatory; latest revisions and full boxed standards are not exhaustively reviewed.
Role/impact-specific profiles, approved composition ledger edges and independent review remain pending.
regional_assumptions: GRI reporting, World Bank ESF/IPF and OECD public-governance guidance have different scopes; none is asserted as universal law or permission to contact individuals.
adversarial_checks: Low influence must not exclude severely affected groups.
Silence and attendance must not become consent.
Representative mandate can be contested and narrower than a group.
Engagement withdrawal does not end an underlying impact.
Scores require scale, date, method and uncertainty.
Public group names do not authorize sensitive-data inference.
Local updates do not change rights, grievances or commitments.
